result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-around payment processor**, but if you're using Shopify, I'd generally recommend **Shopify Payments** instead.

The best choice depends on your e-commerce platform, where your customers live, and how much you sell.

## My top 5 recommendations

![Expert Pricing – Tutora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/s215eOkCrBJePJ6aedIAPORR2dSQKpg4r3kdjo_wlgJnHkyQ2l5DLHu9GE6cuq7DyIdsT5AkGFo_O1lteac7Hs-JP8Zcc66y70mgHCRBP4oIOblvA2wYsTXPnCEklYN9pAD0oC9n8Sn7qYbRw4Qg_jr4Bc3IEn5KMxhAijD_r0bRoq8DtkAmGOw6J64vSDi0?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Easy integration with most online stores.
- Accepts major credit and debit cards.
- Excellent recurring payments and fraud tools.
- No standard monthly processing fee.
  
  Best for WooCommerce, custom websites and online-first businesses.
  
  [Stripe website](https://stripe.com/)

---

![Shopify Payments en México 2026: Comisiones y Cuándo Conviene | Atémpora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uaDWm9NONCBgwuJmZgfert_G31d46hLlI4IfJXvnluf3W2KNJh1m0Hd6lZrNGAPmsyHRrilMlk9B4682s-cn40d1cp-SjQrlAzuD2UEX8iNzkLVIhiPrHZ-Q-BYlhpFfZG8FNzWKzH1o7gk5YwcfdyrA6rRsIlL4g3Z9SJ_DAnqpO6UXb7hjSC1HIAun6cGh?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simplifies checkout and refunds.
- No additional Shopify third-party transaction fee when using it.
  
  Best if your store is already built on Shopify.
  
  [Shopify Payments website](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Recognized and trusted by many shoppers.
- Offers PayPal checkout and card payments.
- Good additional payment option.
  
  Best as a secondary checkout option.
  
  [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Simple setup.
- Combines online and in-person payments.
- Useful inventory and point-of-sale features.
  
  Best if you also sell at markets, events or a physical shop.
  
  [Square Canada](https://squareup.com/ca/en)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Canadian payment processor.
- Interchange-plus pricing.
- Worth comparing as transaction volume grows.
  
  Best for cost-conscious Canadian businesses with growing sales.
  
  [Helcim website](https://www.helcim.com/)

## What I'd recommend in Canada

If your business is based in Canada, I'd shortlist these\:

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Starting a small online store | Stripe |
| Using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Selling internationally | Stripe + PayPal |
| Selling online and in person | Square |
| Growing Canadian business | Helcim |


The important thing is to compare the total cost, including international-card fees, currency conversion, chargebacks and any platform surcharges.
